title: Where to buy in Akihabara
desc: Ten real shops for anime, manga, retro games and hobby goods around Akihabara, with hours, how to pay where known, and the Japanese name to show.
lead: Ten real shops around Akihabara. Hours are shown for today in Tokyo.

g1.name: Around the station
g1.note: Five places within about 5 minutes on foot of Akihabara Station.

g2.name: Up Chuo-dori
g2.note: Five places along Chuo-dori and the side streets north of the station.

know: Hours, closed days and payment come from each shop's official page where one exists. Items marked "not confirmed" were not on any official page, so check before you go.
Shops may close on public holidays or change hours without notice. Check the listing on the map before you go.
Many shops sell used items with a condition grade. Ask the staff if you are unsure.
Bring your passport if you want to shop tax-free. Only Animate says so on its official page.
Walking times are straight-line estimates from the station and are approximate.
credit: Hours, addresses and payment: each shop's official page, checked on 2026-11-10. Gachapon Kaikan and Yodobashi Akiba rely on third-party listings. Map coordinates: GSI address search. The map is a simple sketch, not to scale.

places.area: 1 min from Akihabara Sta. (Electric Town exit)
places.note: A ten-storey building packed with hobby, figure, card and book shops, including K-BOOKS. The official floor list also includes AmiAmi, Volks Hobby Square, Kaiyodo Hobby Lobby Tokyo and Hobby Station.
places.txt: Building 10:00–20:00 (each shop sets its own hours)
places.addr: 東京都千代田区外神田1-15-16

places.area: Radio Kaikan, 3F · 1 min from Akihabara Sta.
places.note: A manga, anime and character goods store on the 3rd floor of Radio Kaikan.
places.addr: 東京都千代田区外神田1-15-16 秋葉原ラジオ会館 3F

places.jp: スーパーポテト 秋葉原店
places.note: A retro video game shop spread over three floors. The 5th floor has a retro arcade and a rest area.
places.addr: 東京都千代田区外神田1-11-2 北林ビル 3F/4F/5F

places.jp: ヨドバシカメラ マルチメディアAkiba
places.note: A large electronics store right outside the station, and also home to the restaurant floor. Which floor holds the toys and hobby goods is not confirmed, so check the floor guide at the entrance.
places.txt: Usually about 9:30–22:00 (third-party listing; check the official site)
places.pay: Not confirmed. Tax-free shopping is listed by a third-party site only.
places.addr: 東京都千代田区神田花岡町1-1

places.area: SEEKBASE, under the tracks · 3 min from Akihabara Sta.
places.note: A retro game and retro PC shop that moved to SEEKBASE, under the rail tracks between Akihabara and Okachimachi. The old shop closed in May 2026.
places.txt: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 12:00–20:00 · Sat, Sun, holidays 11:00–20:00
places.addr: 東京都千代田区神田練塀町15-1 SEEKBASE 3号棟（公式サイト表記は「SEEKBASE内3区画」）

places.note: The flagship character goods shop. Building 1 covers goods, Building 2 is focused on books, and the Annex has game goods. There is a capsule toy floor too. The official site says tax-free shopping is available.
places.txt: Daily 10:00–21:00 (Annex closes at 20:00 on weekends and holidays)
places.pay: Credit cards, IC cards (Suica, PASMO), QR code payments and gift cards
places.addr: 東京都千代田区外神田4-3-1

places.jp: トレーダー秋葉原 本店
places.note: A hobby shop with its own building near the station. Opening hours and product floors are not listed on the official page, so check before you go.
places.txt: Check the official site for hours
places.pay: PayPay is accepted (official notice). Others not confirmed.
places.addr: 東京都千代田区外神田4-2-1

places.jp: 駿河屋 秋葉原本館
places.area: Chuo-dori side · 5 min from Akihabara Sta.
places.note: A used and new goods shop for figures, anime goods and games.
places.addr: 東京都千代田区外神田3丁目11番3号

places.jp: まんだらけ コンプレックス
places.area: Separate building · 6 min from Akihabara Sta.
places.note: An eight-floor building of used manga, doujinshi, toys, cosplay and tokusatsu goods. The buy-back counter is on 1F. It is a standalone building, not inside Radio Kaikan.
places.addr: 東京都千代田区外神田3-11-12

places.jp: 秋葉原ガチャポン会館
places.area: Near Suehirocho Sta. · 2 min from exit 3
places.note: A shop with about 500 capsule toy machines. The listings I found are third-party only and disagree on weekend hours.
places.txt: Weekdays about 11:00–20:00 (listings differ; check before you go)
places.pay: Cards may not be accepted (one listing, not confirmed). Bring cash.
places.addr: 東京都千代田区外神田3-15-5 MNビル1階
